aboutIntro: Version, library stats, and where to get help.
activityIntro: Who requested what, and who reviewed it — most recent first.
jobsIntro: Marquee runs these maintenance tasks on a schedule. Change how often each one runs or give it a time of day, or run one now — that doesn't change its schedule. What they did, and any errors, shows up in Settings › Logs.
onlyAdminRunJobs: Only the admin can run jobs.
onlyAdminChange: Only the admin can change this.
jobFailed: Job failed — check the server logs.
jobPlexSyncDescription: Pulls the latest library state from every connected Plex server.
jobJellyfinSyncDescription: Pulls the latest library state from every connected Jellyfin server.
jobArrSyncDescription: Refreshes tracked/monitored status from every connected Sonarr and Radarr instance.
jobPlexWatchlistDescription: Requests the new movies and shows on the Plex Watchlist of everyone who turned it on, like pressing Request for each.
jobTraktSyncDescription: Requests the new movies and shows on the Trakt watchlists and public lists members keep in sync, like pressing Request for each.
jobNotFoundCheckDescription: Looks for approved requests that Sonarr/Radarr still hasn't found a copy of, and tells the admin and trusted members.
jobDiskSpaceDescription: Records free/used disk space for the storage forecast shown elsewhere in the app.
jobCleanupDescription: Clears out old notifications and activity, year-old disk snapshots, and expired app sign-ins so the database doesn't grow forever.
jobScheduleInvalid: Pick how often: every 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes, every 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 or 12 hours, or once a day at a time.
logsIntro: What the server has been doing, newest at the bottom. Keys, tokens and passwords are masked.
logsLive: {count, plural, one {Updating every few seconds · # line} other {Updating every few seconds · # lines}}
